messages:
alex: FYI opened PR #452 to migrate 'getting-started' -> add python SDK snippet + tone tweaks. Hoping to merge before EOD if CI/docs preview green.

maria: @alex can you add reviewers? I'd like @jamal on the SDK snippet and @olivia on voice edits. Also we should avoid 'we will' phrasing — prefer present tense.

alex: Added reviewers. pinging now. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452 :eyes:

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-452--docs.redwood.ai/ (build #1182) - preview includes updated snippets.

jamal: CI failing lint on the Python snippet, error: 'undefined name client' in code block. Small fix — initialize client with api key.

alex: good catch. Updated snippet:

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.text.generate(model="rw-v1", prompt="Translate to fr: Hello")
print(resp.output[0].content)
```

Note: new .text.generate API.

maria: nice. Tone nit: change 'Translate to fr' -> 'Translate into French:' and avoid contractions.

olivia: Also please ensure 'rw-v1' is flagged as example model; add note about pinning versions in prod. Suggest small callout box.

sam: docs CI still shows a broken anchor for 'private-deployments' link, 404 in preview.

alex: fixed anchor, running another build.

docs-bot: Build succeeded #1183 — preview updated: https://deploy-preview-452--docs.redwood.ai/ :tada:

olivia: Approving content and voice from PM POV. One small nit: for code examples prefer single quotes for strings in Python snippets per style-guide. See style: https://internal.redwood/docs/style#python-quotes

jamal: Approving SDK snippet after quote tweak.

alex: Updated quotes and rebased. Planning to merge in the 30-min merge window (15:00 UTC) unless any objections.

maria: +1 from me. @eng-oncall do we have any release window conflicts? @sre-deploy-bot?

sre-deploy-bot: No conflicts detected for 15:00 UTC slot. Posting merge checklist: tests green, preview OK, no active incidents.

alex: ok merging at 15:00. Thanks everyone :shipit:

jamal: :thumbsup:
